description: Squared-sum activation attention transfer for one student-teacher layer pair using normalized spatial maps and an L2 distance (paper §3.1 Eq. (2), with F_sum^2 and p=2 from §4.1.1). It does not include task cross-entropy. Structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Train a student to match teacher attention maps

name: Attention Transfer Loss

parameters.additional parameters: beta is the only accepted parameter in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.beta: finite nonnegative real scaling factor; None derives 1000/(B*H*W) as in paper §4.1.1 (default None)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because activations are not indexed labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point student activations shaped [B,Cs,H,W] with positive dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns one value per sample, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point fixed-teacher activations shaped [B,Ct,H,W], with matching B,H,W,dtype,device; Ct may differ from Cs and targets are detached
